text:
maria: Heads up — onboarding sample app failing with Node SDK but curl REST works. Quick eyes?
kevin: can you paste the exact requests/responses you tried?
maria: sure. curl (works):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"model":"embed-compact-1","input":["a","b"]}'
```
maria: Node SDK (fails / wrong shape):
```js
const res = await client.embeddings.create({
  model: 'embed-compact-1',
  input: ['a', 'b']
});
console.log(res.data.length); // => 1 (expected 2)
```
maria: SDK returns single embedding for two inputs. Also noticed Authorization header in SDK requests is `ApiKey <value>` (capital K) vs REST `Bearer` in curl.
jonas: hmm. two things: 1) param marshalling bug could be collapsing arrays into a single string for the payload, 2) auth prefix mismatch sounds like a historical env var thing. can you paste a HAR or raw request body from the SDK?
maria: attached minimal repro in thread — here's the outgoing request body from Node (captured):
```json
{"model":"embed-compact-1","input":"[\"a\",\"b\"]"}
```
maria: note input became a string.
kevin: that explains shape. looks like our serializer is JSON.stringify-ing arrays twice in the Node client when building form data for some older http lib.
sam: also been seeing flaky duplicate completions in SDK because of automatic retries on 502 without idempotency keys. not safe for non-idempotent endpoints. has that been filed? :thinking:
kevin: good catch — retry policy is too aggressive for POSTs that aren't idempotent. we should only auto-retry on idempotent safe errors or when client sets idempotency key.
jonas: for immediate unblock, maria: can you try calling embeddings per-item as a temporary workaround? i.e. map over inputs and call client.embeddings.create for each. slo-y but works.
maria: yeah workaround works. but onboarding docs/sample app still broken for new users. noticed the sample app uses `process.env.API_KEY` and our quickstart shows `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...` which is inconsistent. small DX friction.
kevin: action items: 1) fix Node serializer (eng-devex), 2) change SDK auth header to `Bearer` to match REST quickstart or align docs (docs/devex), 3) throttle retry policy for unsafe POSTs (runtime/infra).
kevin: i'm adding a ticket and assigning to eng-devex. tagging @jonas for serializer PR.
jonas: will open PR today. will add a regression test for array payloads and a unit test simulating malformed form-data.
ci-bot: test run triggered for branch eng-devex/serializer-fix — 3 tests failing (embed-shape-test, onboarding-smoke).
deploy-bot: FYI deploy to staging blocked until embed-shape-test passes.
maria: thanks all — once PR merged i can re-run onboarding smoke and update the sample app quickstart to use REDWOOD_API_KEY consistently. :thumbsup:
